content.text: Pick the 2D pixel coordinate [y, x] that represents the point of contact between the person's left index finger and the orange piece. The coordinates are normalized between 0 and 1000, where [0, 0] is the top left and [1000, 1000] is the bottom right. Choices:  A. [297, 471]. B. [410, 390]. C. [329, 432]. D. [717, 301]. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
